info.title: Shopify AI Rank Checker
info.description: Checks how well a Shopify store's products show up when AI shopping assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Copilot search for products, and reports the store's rank and its closest competitors. Searches Shopify's real Global Catalog — the same product index AI assistants read from.
info.x-guidance: Call this when a user wants to know how visible their Shopify store is to AI shopping assistants for specific search terms. Provide the store's myshopify.com domain and a list of search keywords. Use 'simple' report_detail for a quick rank check, or 'full' for complete competitor data and a data quality score. Keep keyword lists to 10 or fewer per call for faster responses; split larger lists into multiple calls.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where this product sits in the search results, starting at 1.

title.title: Title
title.description: The product's name as shown in the catalog.

shopName.title: Shopname
shopName.description: The name of the store selling this product.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: The product's customer rating, if it has one.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: The search phrase this result is about.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Where your product landed in the search results. A blank value means it was not found within the scanned results.

urlFound.title: Urlfound
urlFound.description: The exact web address of your product that showed up in the results, if it was found.

top10Results.title: Top10Results
top10Results.description: The web addresses of the top results shown for this search phrase, including yours if it made the list.

totalScanned.title: Totalscanned
totalScanned.description: How many catalog results were checked for this phrase. Only filled in for the full report.

matchedTitle.title: Matchedtitle
matchedTitle.description: The name of your product that was found. Only filled in for the full report.

competitorsBeating.title: Competitorsbeating
competitorsBeating.description: How many other products ranked ahead of yours for this phrase. Only filled in for the full report.

dataQualityScore.title: Dataqualityscore
dataQualityScore.description: A score from 0 to 100 showing how complete your product listing looks (description, images, options, ratings, categories). Only filled in for the full report when your product is found.

enrichmentChecks.title: Enrichmentchecks
enrichmentChecks.description: A breakdown of which listing details your product has or is missing. Only filled in for the full report when your product is found.

topCompetitors.title: Topcompetitors
topCompetitors.description: Details on the top-ranked products for this phrase. Only filled in for the full report.

notFoundReason.title: Notfoundreason
notFoundReason.description: A plain-English explanation when your product was not found or the check failed.

error.title: Error
error.description: Filled in only if the catalog could not be searched for this phrase.

shop_domain.title: Shop Domain
shop_domain.description: Your store's web address, for example legacybilliards.com or example-store.myshopify.com. You can paste it with or without https://.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: A list of 1 to 10 search phrases you want to check your store's rank for. Split larger lists across multiple calls.

report_detail.title: Report Detail
report_detail.description: Choose 'simple' for a quick rank summary or 'full' for complete competitor and data quality details.

ships_to_country.title: Ships To Country
ships_to_country.description: A two-letter country code, such as US or DE, so results reflect what a shopper in that country would see.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: The version number of this tool.

shop_domain.title: Shop Domain
shop_domain.description: The store address the results are for, after cleanup.

ships_to_country.title: Ships To Country
ships_to_country.description: The shopper country the results reflect.

results.title: Results
results.description: One result per search phrase you asked about, listed in the same order you provided them.
